info.text:
Starbucks booked $222 million from card money nobody spent.
That's fiscal 2025 breakage ($200.4M company-operated + $22.0M licensed): balances Starbucks expects will never be redeemed (FY2025 10-K).
It also owed customers $1.75B in card and Stars balances at Sept 28, 2025: customers pay first, coffee comes later.
Bankrate (2024): 43% of US adults have an unused gift card or store credit; average $244 per holder, up from $116 in 2021.
Federal CARD Act rules: gift card funds last at least 5 years from purchase or last load; inactivity fees only after 1 year. States vary.
Sources: Starbucks FY2025 10-K, Bankrate 2024 survey, 12 CFR 1005.20.
News and education, not financial advice.
